text_block_list.text: Inhale, exhale... The day is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Inhale, exhale... Just you watch, Trainer. This time, I'm taking home first...

text_block_list.text:
No. I'm just taking deep breaths so I
don't get
worked up and have a
nosebleed.

text_block_list.text:

redeem
myself. The last thing I want is to
have to
withdraw because my nose is
bleeding.
